notes.title: Cooking Live Update: Enhanced Experiences Await!
notes.content: Cooking Live latest update fixes issues encountered in various restaurants. Enjoy smoother, more delightful culinary adventures now! 🎉

notes.title: New Episode: Owl and Bear Summer Camp
notes.content:
New Episode: Owl and Bear Summer Camp
- Help Jane bring back to life an abandoned scout camp and return friendship to its guest!

Pancake Party Update
- Take a look at the restaurant's new sea view interior.

New Languages
- Enjoy the game in Spanish, Portuguese, and Hindi now!

Blog Update
- Discover the improved work of the blog with new tasks.

Progress Reset
- Reset your progress and enjoy replaying your favorite episodes.

New DLC
- Get a new unique customer! Choose her in the settings menu and the super cute Gamer Girl will visit your restaurants.

notes.title: New Episode: Family Recipe (macOS Update)
notes.content: Join the son of a renowned chef as he opens his very own restaurant. Amidst simmering family drama, he's focused on one thing - cooking up the town's best burgers using a secret family recipe. Will he flip his way to fame or get grilled under pressure?

notes.title: New Episode: Family Recipe (Windows Update)
notes.content:
Join the son of a renowned chef as he opens his very own restaurant. Amidst simmering family drama, he's focused on one thing - cooking up the town's best burgers using a secret family recipe. Will he flip his way to fame or get grilled under pressure?

Please note that while this update is currently available for Windows only, we are actively working on bringing the new episode to macOS. Stay tuned for more updates!

notes.title: Update 0.31
notes.content:
- Restaurant in the Shell episode changed:
Enjoy modified recipes and a new dessert!

- New booster added:
Use delicious cupcakes to cheer up your customers!

- Interface updated:
Check out the new event icons! Now they reflect the content of the event!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43157681/ea0c9ae65ed006d37250eeee65779d2d2860ee08.png[/img]

notes.title: Update 0.30. PRE-RECORDED Content
notes.content: Let's check out the update together!

notes.title: Update 0.30
notes.content:
- Updates to how the restaurant in the “Sirene Movie Theater” episode works:
We redesigned several objects and changed how the equipment works. It’s like a whole new restaurant now!

- Changes to the shop:
We removed the tabs and improved the offers.

- Equipment delivery fine-tuned:
Get upgrades without going back to the home screen.

- Updates to the interface:
We improved the placement of the button that takes you to a new restaurant and added a button that closes the victory window.

notes.title: Around the World
notes.content:

- Earn tickets and roll the dice to move around the game board.
- Collect showplaces from different countries and earn unique prizes and avatars!
